thread:
clare (AE): quick sync — client requests a 10-day POC: invoice extraction + short policy answers. they want starter prompts, pass/fail metrics, data handling, and pricing. owners + timeline?

dev (SE): i can create a 25-row prompt CSV and example outputs. need sample OCR->text format. can p50 latency be up to 450ms for UI?

clare (AE): they'll send OCR->txt. 450ms p50 is fine if documented.

mina (ML Eng): baseline prompts (strict JSON extractor):
System: Return JSON: vendor, date(ISO), currency, total, items[]. Include confidence 0-1.
User: <OCR_TEXT>
small QA prompt: closed-book retrieval + "No relevant info found." fallback.

oscar (Pricing): we can offer 60k tokens/day credits for the POC. if concurrency >10 we may need temporary reserved pool. need tokens/request estimate.

dev (SE): estimate ~480 tokens per extraction (input+output). peak concurrency ~8-12. batching will help for background jobs.

jamie (Security): customer asks for KMS, short retention, and audit logs. for POC propose: managed keys, redact PII in logs, synthetic data week1, gated real uploads week2 after DPA. i'll draft one-pager.

noah (CSM): proposed acceptance thresholds: vendor & total exact_match >= 90%, hallucination_rate < 3% on policy QA, p50 latency < 500ms, cost <= $0.03/request. owners: dev -> prompt CSV (48h), mina -> eval harness + thresholds (72h), jamie -> security one-pager (EOD), oscar -> credits note (24h), clare/noah -> schedule kickoff (this week).

mina (ML Eng): ack. i'll add eval script snippet and CI hook.

dev (SE): ack. i'll include a deterministic regex fallback for totals with used_fallback flag. uploading artifacts to shared drive when ready.

clare (AE): thanks team — i'll update customer after prompt CSV and security one-pager are posted. meeting tentatively Thu 3pm PT.
